statement: Under these preconditions, the function returns a result r and r is the least integer k >= 0 such that either (a) k = 0 and source = target, or (b) k >= 1 and there exist route indices i_0,...,i_{k-1} with 0 <= i_t < len(routes) for all t, source occurs in routes[i_0], target occurs in routes[i_{k-1}], and for every t with 0 <= t < k-1 there is a stop s that occurs in both routes[i_t] and routes[i_{t+1}]; here a stop s occurs in a route vector v if there is j with 0 <= j < len(v) and v[j] = s. If no such k exists, r = -1.
preconditions: Assume: 1 <= len(routes) <= 500; for every i with 0 <= i < len(routes), 1 <= len(routes[i]) <= 100000 and the entries of routes[i] are pairwise distinct; sum_{i=0}^{len(routes)-1} len(routes[i]) <= 100000; for every i,j with 0 <= i < len(routes) and 0 <= j < len(routes[i]), 0 <= routes[i][j] < 1000000; and 0 <= source < 1000000, 0 <= target < 1000000. All values are interpreted as mathematical integers.
